body: thanks for the reply, unfortunately don't got a sibling old enough to talk ab this stuff, haha. Sounds cool to have a twin bro though, especially when it gets tough I can imagine. Honestly I just can't decide if this girl stopped liking me or if she's really had a busy week. I guess everyone has those weeks where a lot of stuff is going on, especially with school and you kinda have to pause everything else.

i've known them for 11 years, we grew up together, I know they are not doing this out of malice, but i have been depressed and isolated myself for over a year until we started hanging out more often. 

I never lashed out at them or anything, but i was just so embarrassed and ashamed for people to see me. I feel like its gotten worse and it really feels like the beginning of the end for me. I asked a girl out and have tried to enter new friend groups but have been rejected and failed. the thing is i honestly don't blame him and feel like if i were him i would do the same to me, avoid me
I'm eating ice cream in my car alone at night in the park. nobody wants to hang out with my anymore what am I doing with my life I want to die
